title: Prove early native line rigidity from actual main endpoints (no new κ)
body:
The round-three native package asks whether freeing its twelve early line contracts together with later native maps can improve the paid profile. This proves that those early contracts are already forced by the actual scalar incidence graph and fixed main endpoint charts. Each early positive output is `span{45}`, each inverse output is its original source line, and all four intervening scalar contacts are therefore `span{45}`.

The proof relaxes every other native warp relation and all 408 helper boundaries. Eight reachable main-output hyperplanes force each line; invertibility and monotone frame transport force the complete early pair. It is a scoped obstruction, **no new κ** and no optimality claim for changed scalar incidence, main charts or nonnested transports. The selected record is unchanged.

Package: `research/native-contact-resynthesis`. Scientific source: Cao Yifan's frozen round-three `ACTUAL-WORD.json.gz`, SHA256 `7679daa4ec6a40f56fc7f0202379a6f454310e94945aba4f48beaaaafb838d05`. The independent graph and direct-path algorithms import no source optimizer or native interpreter. All 24 output claims are checked through 384 actual forward/backward paths; literal point-set intersections and separate dual elimination agree. Five semantic corruptions reject. PROOF.md explains the hypotheses and explicit escape routes.

Validation on commit `ac61c56dd4e67f16247af3ac1e5fea5ab5f4cbdb`:

- Warning-strict isolated normal and optimized standalone replays pass.
- Registered package replay and metadata/pin checks pass.
- Committed-byte and full source-history checks pass (nine exported files). The initial shallow-history guard was resolved by fetching full metadata history; no guard was bypassed.
- Official committed export and integrity check pass; cold warning-strict scientific replay passes from a temporary Git-free extraction.
- `git diff --check` passes. No unrelated historical/native/Lean/compiler suite was run. Hosted CI is pending at submission.

Fresh canonical main: `bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f`; guidance, selected result and scientific source are unchanged from the initial pin. The final 2026-10-23 05:53:53 UTC overlap report covers 6,692 local notes, 305 open PRs and 4,090 Discussion records with complete reported pagination. Relevant predecessor and live contact-rewrite threads were read; no matching source-bound early-line certificate was found within that coverage. Unpublished work and arbitrary diffs remain limits.

Credit Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis's PR4470/native/controller lineage, Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Nick Petalas's separate PR4919 shared-map criterion, and the retained geometry, phase, precision and outer authors.
